lines.sub: Hi! This is “AI Academy”, lesson seven — “Posts in Telegram”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is AI Academy, lesson seven — Posts in Telegram.

lines.sub: You have a channel, but no time to write. The last post was a month ago.
lines.tts: You have a channel, but no time to write. The last post was a month ago.

lines.sub: Make the character's bot an administrator of the channel — and I'll publish.
lines.tts: Make the character's bot an administrator of the channel — and I'll publish.

lines.sub: “Come up with a post about the new oolong” — I'll write it in my own character, from your knowledge.
lines.tts: Come up with a post about the new oolong — I'll write it in my own character, from your knowledge.

lines.sub: I'll publish it right away or on schedule — say, Friday at ten.
lines.tts: I'll publish it right away or on schedule — say, Friday at ten.

lines.sub: A column like “weekdays at ten — tip of the day” writes itself. All you do is tap “Publish”.
lines.tts: A column like weekdays at ten — tip of the day writes itself. All you do is tap Publish.

lines.sub: A poll works too: “Which tea should we bring next time?”
lines.tts: A poll works too: Which tea should we bring next time?

lines.sub: I'll welcome newcomers to the group — with one message for everyone.
lines.tts: I'll welcome newcomers to the group — with one message for everyone.

lines.sub: And honestly: on behalf of the channel, with no made-up reviews or people.
lines.tts: And honestly: on behalf of the channel, with no made-up reviews or people.
